attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The best option is to build a democratic, mass organization while continuing to run candidates as unapologetic democratic socialists on the Democratic ballot line.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Popular movements against oppression are being built and powerful coalitions are being formed.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Building a working-class party in the United States that can contest for power will require a coalition of labor unions, socialists, and progressive civic and religious organizations.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Popular movements of oppressed people and their allies—including the feminist, anti-racist, queer and trans rights, immigrant, climate, and disability justice movements—are integral to a majoritarian fight for socialism and democracy.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Socialists should participate in independent political organizations, unions, tenant associations, and other mass organizations to reach, organize, and politicize working people.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA membership increases during moments of popular upheaval, and new members should be strategically brought into long-term work in the socialist movement through interconnected struggles.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Today, the right-wing movement is aimed at trans people, and they must be defended.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"A popular front against the right is being built, and a democratic socialist strategy is being advanced within it.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
